id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_090.pack|cs_: "{var:1}! How long have you been there!
"...It's so good that father and son reunited.
"But the people who died and the towns destroyed because of Mordegon will never return.
"{var:1}, Mordegon has the power to destroy the world.
"Having seen that power, do you still mean to fight him?
"Oh, you're joking! It's written on your face that you want to beat him. I know your heart without words.
"I said I'd bring smiles back to the world and held my Parade of Smiles to cheer everyone up...
"But smiles can't return unless Mordegon is defeated.
"So I'll come along on your journey again!
"...But first, I have one favor to ask.
"I don't mind dying fighting Mordegon, but I can't drag the parade into it.
"I want to leave them with someone trustworthy. I know exactly one person...
"But he's really scary, and I'd be nervous alone. Please! {var:1}, come with me?
"Oh, {var:1}, you tease! You'll come really, won't you?
"Thanks! Let's tell the parade what I said. I'll wait outside!"
